summary: Iteration 56 — Contributor Thank-You (with silent-skip when RESEND_API_KEY empty) + Featured Tip Analytics (events + analytics endpoints + admin chart + opt-in chip). Backend 12/12 pytest passing. Frontend home FeaturedTipStrip fires impression on mount, open on click, dismiss on X (verified network + install_id in localStorage). Admin AnalyticsChart renders top-of-dashboard with 4 stat cards, recharts horizontal bars, days-select + refresh, opt-in chip renders on pending tip rows.

issues: Initial mount logs recharts warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0'. Cosmetic — ResponsiveContainer settles before paint but the warning is emitted twice on first paint. Consider wrapping in a stable min-height container or gating render on container ref.
Stat card testid for 'dismisses' is 'analytics-total-dismissed' (past-tense label) and Legend series is 'dismisses' — inconsistent naming across chart/legend/testid. Not a bug, minor polish.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1529 lines — repeat feedback from iter54/55 to split community/digest/analytics into a sub-router. It is now clearly overdue.
GET /api/community/analytics does an in-memory sort and enrichment but does not paginate. Fine at current scale; add a Limit param (top-N) once the promoted-tip catalog grows.
Analytics events collection has no TTL index — long-term storage will grow unbounded. Recommend a Mongo TTL on `at` (e.g., 180 days) or a periodic prune job.

communityAnalytics.js flushes on visibility 'hidden' via sendBeacon (good) but the 5s timer + 5-event threshold means a single impression fires an HTTP POST after 5s idle — could be batched with the 'open' click that usually follows. Acceptable trade-off for correctness.
AnalyticsChart Legend labels are lowercase ('impressions','opens','dismisses') — inconsistent with capitalised stat-card headers ('Impressions','Opens','Dismissed','Unique installs'). Cosmetic.
Recharts 'width(-1) height(-1)' console warning on first render — see design_issues.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all requested data-testid flows verified except deep Share-dialog flow — verified by code review)

test_credentials: ADMIN_TOKEN=[REDACTED_ADMIN_TOKEN]. Admin UI unlock: localStorage.setItem('irr.admin_token', <token>) then load /admin/community.

Analytics events use ephemeral tip_ids TEST_analytics_A_<uuid8> / TEST_analytics_B_<uuid8> and are purged from community_events at module teardown via motor. UI opt-in-chip check inserted + deleted 'TEST_iter56 UI chip' tip.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_contributor_and_analytics.py is idempotent — safe to re-run. It relies on env: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, MONGO_URL, DB_NAME. Use `set -a && . ./frontend/.env && . ./backend/.env && set +a` before pytest. The 'thank-you skipped: Resend not configured' log line was verified in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log after promote (2 occurrences). CommunityShareDialog interactive flow (open guide → add card → save → click share icon on user card) was NOT exercised by Playwright due to depth — verified only via code (testids present: community-share-dialog, share-optin-checkbox, share-email-input, share-remember-consent, share-consent-line, share-submit). If retesting, note that share icon only appears on `isUser=true` cards.
